description: This file defines the internal class GatewayManager responsible for managing the list of gateway nodes in an Orleans cluster. It handles gateway discovery, health status, round-robin selection, and periodic refreshes, including integration with external gateway list providers.

classes.name: GatewayManager
classes.description: An internal class responsible for managing the list of known and dead gateways, performing periodic refreshes, and selecting gateways for client requests.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, retrieves the initial list of gateways, and starts the periodic refresh task.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh timer and waits for the refresh task to complete.

methods.name: MarkAsDead
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as dead, removing it from the active list.

methods.name: MarkAsUnavailableForSend
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as temporarily unavailable for sending requests.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GatewayManager's current state.

methods.name: GetLiveGateway
methods.description: Selects a live gateway using round-robin strategy.

methods.name: GetLiveGateways
methods.description: Returns the current list of live gateways, triggering a refresh if the list is empty.

methods.name: IsGatewayAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific gateway is currently available.

methods.name: ExpediteUpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Triggers an immediate refresh of the gateway list if not already in progress.

methods.name: PeriodicallyRefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Continuously refreshes the gateway list at regular intervals.

methods.name: RefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of gateways from the provider and updates the internal state.

methods.name: UpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Updates the list of live gateways based on the latest data, removing dead gateways and closing connections to them.

methods.name: CloseEvictedGatewayConnections
methods.description: Closes connections to gateways that are no longer active.
